verdict.rationale: Maritime documents first-party webhooks: you subscribe a URL and Maritime POSTs a signed JSON body on every agent lifecycle event, so programmatic consumers can receive events without polling. Support rests on a single docs snippet with no further detail. Missing for 10: a documented event-type catalog beyond lifecycle events, delivery/retry and signature-verification details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Subscribe a URL, and Maritime POSTs a signed JSON body on every lifecycle event.
